proposed.sourceName: South African National Halaal Authority (SANHA) — E631 (Sodium 5-Inosinate)
proposed.paraphrase: SANHA classifies E631 (disodium/sodium 5-inosinate) as Mushbooh (doubtful): it may be derived from meat extract, dried sardines, or microbiological fermentation, so the source must be verified — pork or non-halal-meat sourced E631 is not permissible.

proposed.sourceName: Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband — Fatwa 790=559/H on E-code additives (incl. E631)
proposed.paraphrase: Asked whether foods with additive codes E473–E478, E631, E635, E640 and E920 are halal or haram, Darul Uloom Deoband declined a blanket prohibition: 'We have no confirmation about the code numbers being Haram. You should write the ingredients of the product, then we can have a say' — the status of E631 turns on its actual source and must be examined case by case.

researcherNote: E631-lenient recovery (was: needed 2nd source).
